limitations: Complete original local Git tutorial/sandbox, original 36 levels with English and Simplified Chinese original texts bundled; other language data/selection entries removed to meet unchanged host cache budget. Simulates Git only: no actual repository, shell, credential, git hosting or remote network connection. Original Mercurial support included but not exhaustively tested.
